about_the_game:
Coffee Talk Tokyo returns as a cozy, narrative-driven visual novel set in a late-night café in modern Tokyo. Brew drinks, listen to heartfelt stories, and shape the lives of humans and yōkai alike through meaningful conversations and impactful choices.

In a city of paper and steel, where old and new coexist, a small café becomes a refuge from the sweltering summer heat. Behind the counter, you serve the right drink at the right moment while your customers open up about love, loss, identity, and second chances, all to chill lo-fi beats.

What You’ll Do Behind the Counter

• Brew hot and cold drinks for humans and yōkai

• Listen to deeply personal, branching stories

• Make dialogue choices that influence character outcomes

• Unlock hidden Tomodachill posts through interactive hashtags

• Discover multiple endings shaped by your decisions

Every shift brings new conversations, new connections, and new possibilities.

New Café, New Stories

While the atmosphere feels familiar, the customers and their journeys are entirely new.

You’ll meet:

• Kenji, a traditional kappa salaryman searching for meaning after retirement.

• Vin, the Barista’s assistant coping with a fractured past and the lingering consequences of a previous disaster.

• Ayame, a happy-go-lucky but recently deceased It girl struggling to understand her unexpected afterlife.

And many more new faces, each story unfolds based on how you listen, respond, and serve.

Lo-fi Beats Soundtrack by Andrew "AJ" Jeremy

The composer of Coffee Talk and Coffee Talk Episode 2, Andrew “AJ” Jeremy, returns with an all-new lo-fi soundtrack to accompany every shift behind the counter.

Brew, Create, and Stay Cool

Serve returning favorites and discover new drink options, including refreshing cold beverages perfect for Tokyo’s summer heat.

Enhance your latte art with sprinkle stencils, then personalize each drink by adding milk and etching your own finishing touches.

Master Tomodachill

Engage with your customers beyond the café through Tomodachill, the in-game social network.

Tomodachill now features clickable hashtags. By following these hashtags, you can uncover hidden posts from characters you do not yet follow, revealing new layers of the story like a trail of breadcrumbs.

Some hidden posts contain important clues that influence how storylines unfold and can affect your path toward the best endings. Others expand the wider Coffee Talk world, sometimes offering glimpses of familiar faces.

Every post, reply, and connection may matter more than it first appears.
